# Manual incoming completion needs both model completeness and native validity

Entry 1491 combines isIncomingEditedComplete with incomingEmailForm.checkValidity. Sanitization errors leave completed false, and config-updated carries that boolean. In current source, Exchange completeness follows its URL/username/auth branch while other protocols need hostname, port and username. Do not replace this edit-stage predicate with the stricter isComplete predicate used after probing. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.

Scope: Account Hub manual validation.
